title: The Fighting Cricket
synopsis: A tale of the hardships facing a man trying to find a fierce cricket for the emperor!

fullText.simplified:
有个叫成名的人，是个好人，不爱说话。花阴市的市长看到有个村里没有村长，就让他去当这个村长。成名很不想当村长，但又不知道怎么说“不”。村里大大小小要用钱的事情都找村长要。成名当这个村长不到一年，家里的钱都快用完了。
    又到了秋天，又到了每年要交蛐蛐的时候了。
    去哪儿找蛐蛐交给市长？家里已经没钱了，买不起蛐蛐。成名每天为了蛐蛐的事吃不好，睡不好。他对妻子说：“我真的想死的心都有了。”
    “死，有用吗？”妻子说，“我们没钱买蛐蛐，那就自己去捉吧！说不定真能捉到一只蛐蛐呢？”
    成名想：也只能这样了。
    第二天一大早，成名就拿着笼子去捉蛐蛐了。一天下来，他所有的地方都找了，草地里、石头下面，成名跳上跳下，能找的地方都找了，都没有找到蛐蛐。
    第三天、第四天……成名每天都是一大早出去找蛐蛐，每天都找到很晚，但都没有找到蛐蛐。
fullText.traditional:
有個叫成名的人，是個好人，不愛說話。花陰市的市長看到有個村裡沒有村長，就讓他去當這個村長。成名很不想當村長，但又不知道怎麼說“不”。村裡大大小小要用錢的事情都找村長要。成名當這個村長不到一年，家裡的錢都快用完了。
    又到了秋天，又到了每年要交蛐蛐的時候了。
    去哪兒找蛐蛐交給市長？家裡已經沒錢了，買不起蛐蛐。成名每天為了蛐蛐的事吃不好，睡不好。他對妻子說：“我真的想死的心都有了。”
    “死，有用嗎？”妻子說，“我們沒錢買蛐蛐，那就自己去捉吧！說不定真能捉到一隻蛐蛐呢？”
    成名想：也只能這樣了。
    第二天一大早，成名就拿著籠子去捉蛐蛐了。一天下來，他所有的地方都找了，草地裡、石頭下面，成名跳上跳下，能找的地方都找了，都沒有找到蛐蛐。
    第三天、第四天……成名每天都是一大早出去找蛐蛐，每天都找到很晚，但都沒有找到蛐蛐。

sentences.simplified: 有个叫成名的人，是个好人，不爱说话。
sentences.traditional: 有個叫成名的人，是個好人，不愛說話。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu ge jiào chéng míng de rén shì ge hǎo rén bú ài shuō huà
sentences.english: There was a man called Cheng Ming. He was a good person who didn’t like to talk.

sentences.simplified: 花阴市的市长看到有个村里没有村长，
sentences.traditional: 花陰市的市長看到有個村裡沒有村長，
sentences.pinyin: huā yīn shì de shì zhǎng kàn dào yǒu ge cūn lǐ méi yǒu cūn zhǎng
sentences.english: The mayor of Huayin City noticed that there was a village that didn’t have a chief, ..

sentences.simplified: 就让他去当这个村长。
sentences.traditional: 就讓他去當這個村長。
sentences.pinyin: jiù ràng tā qù dāng zhè ge cūn zhǎng
sentences.english: .. so he made Cheng Ming the chief of that village.

sentences.simplified: 成名很不想当村长，但又不知道怎么说“不”。
sentences.traditional: 成名很不想當村長，但又不知道怎麼說“不”。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng hěn bù xiǎng dāng cūn zhǎng dàn yòu bù zhī dào zěn me shuō bù
sentences.english: Cheng Ming really didn’t want to be a village chief, but he also didn’t know how to say “no”.

sentences.simplified: 村里大大小小要用钱的事情都找村长要。
sentences.traditional: 村裡大大小小要用錢的事情都找村長要。
sentences.pinyin: cūn lǐ dà dà xiǎo xiǎo yào yòng qián de shì qing dōu zhǎo cūn zhǎng yào
sentences.english: In the village, when money was required for matters big and small, the village chief would be asked to provide it.

sentences.simplified: 成名当这个村长不到一年，家里的钱都快用完了。
sentences.traditional: 成名當這個村長不到一年，家裡的錢都快用完了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng dāng zhè ge cūn zhǎng bú dào yì nián jiā lǐ de qián dōu kuài yòng wán le
sentences.english: Cheng Ming had been the village chief for less than a year, and almost all of the family’s money had been spent.

sentences.simplified: 又到了秋天，又到了每年要交蛐蛐的时候了。
sentences.traditional: 又到了秋天，又到了每年要交蛐蛐的時候了。
sentences.pinyin: yòu dào le qiū tiān yòu dào le měi nián yào jiāo qū qū de shí hou le
sentences.english: Autumn arrived again, and so did that time of year when they had to hand over a cricket.

sentences.simplified: 去哪儿找蛐蛐交给市长？家里已经没钱了，买不起蛐蛐。
sentences.traditional: 去哪兒找蛐蛐交給市長？家裡已經沒錢了，買不起蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: qù nǎ'r zhǎo qū qū jiāo gěi shì zhǎng jiā lǐ yǐ jīng méi qián le mǎi bù qǐ qū qū
sentences.english: Where to go and look for a cricket to give the mayor? The family now had no money, and couldn’t afford to buy a cricket.

sentences.traditional: 成名每天為了蛐蛐的事吃不好，睡不好。他對妻子說：“我真的想死的心都有了。”

sentences.english: Cheng Ming ate and slept badly every day because of the cricket.  He said to his wife, “I really want to die.”

sentences.simplified: “死，有用吗？”妻子说，
sentences.traditional: “死，有用嗎？”妻子說，
sentences.pinyin: sǐ yǒu yòng ma qī zi shuō
sentences.english: “Death, what use is that?” his wife said.

sentences.simplified: “我们没钱买蛐蛐，那就自己去捉吧！说不定真能捉到一只蛐蛐呢？”
sentences.traditional: “我們沒錢買蛐蛐，那就自己去捉吧！說不定真能捉到一隻蛐蛐呢？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men méi qián mǎi qū qū nà jiù zì jǐ qù zhuō ba shuō bu dìng zhēn néng zhuō dào yì zhī qū qū ne
sentences.english: “We don’t have the money to buy a cricket, so go and catch one yourself! Maybe you can really catch a cricket?”

sentences.simplified: 成名想：也只能这样了。
sentences.traditional: 成名想：也只能這樣了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng xiǎng yě zhǐ néng zhè yàng le
sentences.english: Cheng Ming thought he had no other choice than to do just that.

sentences.simplified: 第二天一大早，成名就拿着笼子去捉蛐蛐了。
sentences.traditional: 第二天一大早，成名就拿著籠子去捉蛐蛐了。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān yí dà zǎo chéng míng jiù ná zhe lóng zi qù zhuō qū qū le
sentences.english: First thing next morning, Cheng Ming took a cage and went to catch a cricket.

sentences.simplified: 一天下来，他所有的地方都找了，草地里、石头下面，
sentences.traditional: 一天下來，他所有的地方都找了，草地裡、石頭下面，
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān xià lai tā suǒ yǒu de dì fang dōu zhǎo le cǎo dì lǐ shí tou xià miàn
sentences.english: At the end of the day, he’d looked everywhere, in the meadow, under rocks, ..

sentences.traditional: 成名跳上跳下，能找的地方都找了，都沒有找到蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng tiào shàng tiào xià néng zhǎo de dì fang dōu zhǎo le dōu méi yǒu zhǎo dào qū qū
sentences.english: .. Cheng Ming jumped up and down, looking everywhere he could, but didn’t find a cricket anywhere.

sentences.simplified: 第三天、第四天……成名每天都是一大早出去找蛐蛐，
sentences.traditional: 第三天、第四天……成名每天都是一大早出去找蛐蛐，
sentences.pinyin: dì sān tiān dì sì tiān chéng míng měi tiān dōu shì yí dà zǎo chū qù zhǎo qū qū
sentences.english: The third day, and the fourth day … Cheng Ming went out to look for a cricket first thing every day, ..

sentences.simplified: 每天都找到很晚，但都没有找到蛐蛐。
sentences.traditional: 每天都找到很晚，但都沒有找到蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān dōu zhǎo dào hěn wǎn dàn dōu méi yǒu zhǎo dào qū qū
sentences.english: .. and looked every day until it was very late, but he didn’t find a cricket.

sentence_translations: There was a man called Cheng Ming. He was a good person who didn’t like to talk.
The mayor of Huayin City noticed that there was a village that didn’t have a chief, ..
.. so he made Cheng Ming the chief of that village.
Cheng Ming really didn’t want to be a village chief, but he also didn’t know how to say “no”.
In the village, when money was required for matters big and small, the village chief would be asked to provide it.
Cheng Ming had been the village chief for less than a year, and almost all of the family’s money had been spent.
Autumn arrived again, and so did that time of year when they had to hand over a cricket.
Where to go and look for a cricket to give the mayor? The family now had no money, and couldn’t afford to buy a cricket.
Cheng Ming ate and slept badly every day because of the cricket.  He said to his wife, “I really want to die.”
“Death, what use is that?” his wife said.
“We don’t have the money to buy a cricket, so go and catch one yourself! Maybe you can really catch a cricket?”
Cheng Ming thought he had no other choice than to do just that.
First thing next morning, Cheng Ming took a cage and went to catch a cricket.
At the end of the day, he’d looked everywhere, in the meadow, under rocks, ..
.. Cheng Ming jumped up and down, looking everywhere he could, but didn’t find a cricket anywhere.
The third day, and the fourth day … Cheng Ming went out to look for a cricket first thing every day, ..
.. and looked every day until it was very late, but he didn’t find a cricket.
